title: Error monitoring and structured logging
description: Integrate Sentry error tracking and structured JSON logger with PII redaction
completion: Created lib/server/logger.ts: structured JSON logger with levels (debug/info/warn/error/fatal), PII redaction (passwords, tokens, secrets, cookies), bigint serialization, configurable LOG_LEVEL. Created instrumentation.ts for conditional Sentry init (requires @sentry/nextjs + SENTRY_DSN). Added SENTRY_DSN and LOG_LEVEL to env config and .env.example. Wired logger into apiHandler (request/response/error logging) and replaced server-side console.error calls in ai-insights, finance report, and cashiers routes.
